headline: The squall becomes terrain — TIDAL RUSH rain is built, merge waits on a green main
lede: Rain on the forge ocean now shoves your hull, bites your top speed and dims the gates you must read. The build is complete and proven at 84 gates; only the red-main freeze stands between it and your phone.

notes.text: #3191 (never-dry pick): rain is a field, not wallpaper — drag bites v_term 19→~16.9 m/s inside the band, a seeded crosswind walks you off line, gates dim toward storm fog by the rain at THEIR point, and the band edge answers with a wind-gust cue. Sunny water stays an exact zero.
tidalcheck 71→84 with three proven killers (rainoff, push, judge all die); tidaldrive won a full storm race in headless Chrome through live rain with zero page errors; contractcheck 15/15.
